title: System Design - Part 1
description: System design covering requirements analysis, architecture patterns, scalability, availability, load balancing, caching, databases, Redis, queues, microservices, and API gateways. This submodule covers: System design fundamentals, Requirements, Architecture, Scalability, Availability, Reliability.
learning_outcomes: Analyze system requirements and define architecture
Design scalable and highly available systems
Implement load balancing and caching strategies
